summary: One declared recovery-route table per workflow definition is the only owner of cross-step correction. The closed two-trigger set (unhealthy_verdict and disproved_premise_at_complete) pairs each trigger with one engine-owned recovery action, the registration gate refuses an undeclared or non-producer route, the runtime cross-step reader is one function, and the artifact-staleness state binds the production frontier to the declared target so only an accepted worker delivery or a typed target production direct action clears the bit. Definitions derive from one canonical source and declare their own table; the liveness and conformance checks cover every registered definition exhaustively; CD-0172 and CD-0186 keep the complete-step supersede bound to implementation and break_fix with exact approval terminal.
title: Declared recovery routes preserve artifact truth
